description: This file contains shell script code for testing interactions between Git and Perforce (p4), including handling filenames with shell metacharacters, creating and deleting files, and managing branches with special characters. It orchestrates commands for setting up a Perforce depot, performing Git operations, and verifying correct behavior with filenames that have shell metacharacters.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a Perforce server daemon for testing.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up temporary Git repositories after tests.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository for testing.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup actions to run after a test completes.
